tours.title: Rome Highlights City Guided Tour by Golf Cart with Gelato
tours.titlePlain: Rome Highlights City Guided Tour by Golf Cart with Gelato
description: Explore Rome by golf cart. We have seven departures daily, showcasing some of the city’s biggest highlights: Rione Monti, Trevi Fountain, Spanish Steps, Piazza Navona, Pantheon, Minerva Square, Castel Sant’ Angelo, Vatican, Trastevere and Colosseum etc. (attraction stops may vary by order).
features: Bottle of water + headsets for your comfort
Child 0-6 y.o. €9 discount (children cannot sit on lap according to Italian Law). Baby chair provided.

tours.title: Rome Catacomb & Appian Way Small-Group Tour by Golf Cart
tours.titlePlain: Rome Catacomb & Appian Way Small-Group Tour by Golf Cart
description: Step back in time and ride along the legendary Appian Way, with the guidance of our experienced tour leaders with three departures daily. You will experience: Colosseum, Terme di Caracalla, Church of Domine Quo Vadis, Catacombs of Saint Sebastian (inside visit of 40 minutes), Basilica of Saint Sebastian ad Catacumbas (inside visit), Circus of Maxentius, Appian Way, Pyramid of Caius Cestius, Circus Maximus, Bocca della Verità, Theatre of Marcellus etc.
features: Bottle of water + headsets for your comfort
Entry tickets for the Catacombs included
Child 0-6 y.o. €9 discount (children cannot sit on lap according to Italian Law). Baby chair provided.

tours.title: Rome in a Day by Golf Cart Pizza 🍕 & Gelato 🍧
tours.titlePlain: Rome in a Day by Golf Cart Pizza & Gelato
description: Let us drive you around the city in comfort, 3 hours tour showing you all the sites. With departures every day at 11:00am 7:00pm from our location on via Cavour 138 for a great tour with a guide at your disposal. Best tour for people with limited time.
features: Bottle of water + headsets for your comfort
Child 0-6 y.o. €9 discount (children cannot sit on lap according to Italian Law). Baby chair provided.
